statement: Regeneration of the decision-22 publication binding under contract release final-v5-contracts-v1.8 after the decision-23 exposure-scale reseal. The approved binding and Catalog bytes reproduced exactly; only the generation provenance changed.

unchanged_approved_bytes.note: Author decision 22 approved the publication-binding.json bytes; the v1.8 regeneration reproduces those exact binding and Catalog bytes, so the approval of the binding bytes is not invalidated.

provenance_delta.interpretation: The 20 changed values are limited to the decision-23 approval reseal, the appended author-decision bytes and digest, the contract release/index digest, the new live-observation identity, and its derived set-algebra and binding-input-identity summaries. No result, dependency, outcome, row, column or schema digest appears in the delta; cardinalities and coverage are unchanged.

validation.command: final-v5-publication-binding validate --repo-root <repo> --input-dir <private 0700 copy of publication-binding-v1.8 containing exactly the three closed files>
validation.note: The tracked directory also contains this regeneration record as a fourth file, and Git does not record directory permissions, so in-place validation is not the recomputation path; this is consistent with Decision 23's private-copy procedure for v1.5.
